prompt: Create an original 150 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 94 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A lively and rhythmic Middle Eastern instrumental piece featuring oud, qanun, acoustic guitar, bass, and traditional percussion. The intricate melody creates an exotic and cultural atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼且富有节奏感的中东器乐作品，以乌德琴、卡农琴、原声吉他、贝斯和传统打击乐器为特色。错综复杂的旋律营造出异域风情的文化氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
